events.summary:
SVRABR

The National Weather Service in Aberdeen has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northwestern Jones County in central South Dakota...

* Until 930 PM CDT.

* At 849 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 7 miles south of
Capa, or 15 miles northwest of Murdo, moving southeast at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect
wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* This severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly rural areas of
Northwestern Jones County.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
An active monsoon pattern will continue to bring scattered to
numerous heavy showers and scattered thunderstorms across portions
Yap State through tonight. Frequent lightning, wind gusts to 30
knots, and choppy seas can be expected with thunderstorms. Residents
across Yap State should monitor local forecasts and heed advice of
emergency managers when heavy rainfall occurs. Locally heavy rainfall
could result in additional flooding and mudslides, particularly in
areas that experienced flooding last week following the more than 22
inches of rain that fell on Thursday.

Inter-island travel will be challenging through at least tonight.
Combined seas of 6 to 8 feet with occasional larger sets will be
near, but just below, the Small Craft Advisory criteria of 10 ft.
Consider postponing inter-island travel until conditions improve.
